summary: Add babysit --watch guards for base-branch file overlap and restart-safe event memory with six-hour retention (#1246).
migration_impact: No config changes. Watch loops may surface base-branch overlap warnings and will not replay comment events older than about six hours after a restart.
migration_guidance: Upgrade plate-core when this release ships.
No action required unless custom automation parses wake summaries; optional base_file_overlap block may appear when the integration branch moves into PR-touched paths.
agent_notes: Watcher guard ideas adapted from t3dotgg/tstack pr-wait (MIT, copyright Theo Browne); PLATE implementation is original. Event ledger persists under .agentic/babysit/*.events.json with atomic JSON writes.
